name: European Business Wallet Owner Identification Data
description: Identifies the owner of a European Business Wallet - an economic operator or public sector body - by the unique identifier and official name held by the authentic source that issued it.

display.name: Business Wallet Owner ID
display.description: Identifies the organisation that owns this European Business Wallet.

display.label: Organisation identifier
display.description: Cross-border unique identifier of the wallet owner under Article 9 of the European Business Wallet proposal: the EUID where available, otherwise a similarly constructed per-issuer identifier, such as SEBOLREG.123456789.

display.label: Organisation name
display.description: Official name of the wallet owner, taken from the relevant register or official record.

display.label: Attestation category
display.description: Legal category under which this attestation is issued: QEAA or PuB-EAA.

display.label: Expiry date
display.description: Administrative expiry date, for when administrative validity differs from the credential's technical expiry.

display.label: Issuing authority
display.description: Name of the administrative authority, the Commission for Union entities, or the qualified trust service provider that issued this attestation.

display.label: Issuing country
display.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country or territory of the issuing provider.
